title: Text: DET Al Avila ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: I saw something about teams being able to cut arb guys for 1/6 of their contract in spring training. Can you explain that?

Contracts are not guaranteed. But if a club does cut a guy that is performing well in the Spring then that club may face a grievance from the union. Not really supposed to make a cut based on getting rid of the contract.
Ok...so that’s not really a likely outcome
Cool, thanks. Sorry about all the texts yesterday.
